description: A glowing chain drops from the ceiling line to 'hang' the picture frame, with soft wall light and a swaying shadow. Stays up until you fade the chain surface out.

surfaces._comment: Each show surface is a MadMapper surface (friendly name from addresses.json) carrying one material. 'preview' is its rectangle [x, y, w, h] on a 16:9 stage (0-1, y down) for preview/show.html only.
